page.layout: One printed page, single column of dictionary entries; running head "C O." centred at top; page number 129 at top right; catchword "Coniam" at bottom right; signature "I" at bottom centre. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: colonos: Dare, dividere agrum novis colonis. Collocare in aliquo loco novos colonos. Instituere civitatem, Cic. Coloniam in agro ponere, Liv.
Color dilutus] Color lentus, surdus, obsoletus, languidus, Plin.
Color floridus] Color suavis, Cic. Color satur, Virg. Color vivus, Mart.
Color purpureus] Color diffusus sanguine. Rubor, Cic. Rubor in malis, Plin. Candor purpureo sanguine diffusus, Stat. Verecundus color, Hor. Sanguinolentus color, Ovid.

Colore ambiguo] Inclinans ad luteum colorem. Languescente colore in suspectu refulgens. Candicans è rufo. Color violas sentiens, Plin. Albicans ex rutilo. Ex auro flavus. Ex aureolo varius, Col. Viridis communicatio coloris cum, Plin. Ambiguo colore nitens, Amm.

Colorem mutare] Non constat ei color, Liv. Errant varii colores in vultu, Virg. In varios colores transfire. Trahit colorem croci. Descendit ad &c. Plin. Variat sol ortum maculis, Virg. Migrare in alius colorem, Lucr.
Colorare] Colorem inducere, Vitr. Inficere colore, Plin. Tingere, Mart. Fricare lanam, Virg. Sufficere lanam, Cic. Rutilare comam, Amm.
Coloratus] Tinctus, Ovid. Contactus colore croci, Lucr. Colorea vestis, Causab. Colorius, Metiens colorem, Virg. Suffecta sole nubes, Sen. Infectus, Plin. Fucatus, Virg.
Colossus] Statua colossea, Spart. Colossicum signum, Colosseus Nero, Plin.
Columbus ferus] Columba agrestis & saxatilis, Var. Turricola, Scal. Venago, Gaz.
Columbarium] Columbaria, orum, Varr. Latibula columbarum, Id.
Columna in aedificiis] Tibicen, Iuv. Pila, Plin.
Coma] Capillamentum, Suet. Coma plicata, nexa. Subtilia & textilia capillamenta, Ter. Caesaries, Serv. Frontis tegumentum, Athen. Capilli, Cic. Capillitium, Apul.

page.notes: Several entries are partly obscured by show-through from the reverse page, which was not transcribed. The word "Coniam" at foot is a catchword. Some abbreviations of authors (e.g. "Gaz.", "Causab.") are printed as shown.
